disambiguation: Not just a note-taking tool; it functions as a comprehensive expense tracker and accounting record analyzer.
extras: Data is stored locally within the vault; supports multiple currency symbols (¥, 元, 块).
problem: Manually tracking and analyzing daily expenses within a note-taking application is time-consuming and inconsistent.

relations.evidence: Install the community plugin Obsidian Advanced URI.

summary: A daily expense tracking plugin that automatically parses accounting records from daily notes and provides statistical analysis of income and spending.
